label: r4c2
name: r3c3 with wider row/col channels
hypothesis: Widen the circular row/column convolutions from 24 to 40 channels in the front end and from 20 to 28 in the deep block. Undoing the X/2 shift for every target, missing and height channel needs roughly one output channel per shifted input channel, so 24 ReLU channels may be a bottleneck for exact per-layer alignment. Compute rises to about 1.8x. Refuted if the mean is at or below 0.46.
